t: 国王查理一世在400名士兵的陪同下,试图以叛国罪逮捕5名议员,只是为了发现这些人被告发并逃跑.
te: King Charles I, accompanied by 400 soldiers, attempts to arrest five members of Parliament for treason, only to discove…
dz: 英国内战:国王查理一世在400名士兵的陪同下,试图以叛国罪逮捕5名议员,只是为了发现这些人被告发并逃跑.
de: English Civil War: King Charles I, accompanied by 400 soldiers, attempts to arrest five members of Parliament for treason, only to discover the men had been tipped off and fled.

t: 教法成为了法律,英格兰教会的主教不得在上议院任职.
te: The Clergy Act becomes law, excluding bishops of the Church of England from serving in the House of Lords.
dz: 教法成为了法律,英格兰教会的主教不得在上议院任职.
de: The Clergy Act becomes law, excluding bishops of the Church of England from serving in the House of Lords.

t: 一个邦联的爱尔兰民兵在基尔鲁什战役中试图阻止王室军队的进步被打倒.
te: A Confederate Irish militia is routed in the Battle of Kilrush when it attempts to halt the progress of a Royalist Army.
dz: 爱尔兰邦联战争:一个邦联的爱尔兰民兵在基尔鲁什战役中试图阻止王室军队的进步被打倒.
de: Irish Confederate Wars: A Confederate Irish militia is routed in the Battle of Kilrush when it attempts to halt the progress of a Royalist Army.

t: 保罗·德·乔梅德(Paul de Chomedy),西德·迈森纳沃(Sieur de Mais…
te: Paul de Chomedey, Sieur de Maisonneuve founds the Ville Marie de Montréal.
dz: 保罗·德·乔梅德(Paul de Chomedy),西德·迈森纳沃(Sieur de Maisonneuve)发现了"维勒·玛丽·德·蒙特雷亚尔".
de: Paul de Chomedey, Sieur de Maisonneuve founds the Ville Marie de Montréal.

t: 从这一天起,英格兰查理一世授予的所有荣誉都被议会追溯废除.
te: From this date all honors granted by Charles I of England are retroactively annulled by Parliament.
dz: 从这一天起,英格兰查理一世授予的所有荣誉都被议会追溯废除.
de: From this date all honors granted by Charles I of England are retroactively annulled by Parliament.

t: 查尔斯一世在诺丁汉提高了他的标准,这标志着英国内战的开始.
te: Charles I raises his standard in Nottingham, which marks the beginning of the English Civil War.
dz: 查尔斯一世在诺丁汉提高了他的标准,这标志着英国内战的开始.
de: Charles I raises his standard in Nottingham, which marks the beginning of the English Civil War.

t: 第二次圣萨尔瓦多战役：荷兰人迫使西班牙在圣萨尔瓦多（今台湾基隆）的驻军投降，结束了西班牙在福尔…
te: Second Battle of San Salvador: The Dutch force the Spanish garrison at San Salvador (modern day Keelung, Taiwan) to sur…
dz: 荷兰-葡萄牙战争：第二次圣萨尔瓦多战役：荷兰人迫使西班牙在圣萨尔瓦多（今台湾基隆）的驻军投降，结束了西班牙在福尔摩沙的短暂殖民地，并由新的荷兰政府取而代之。
de: Dutch–Portuguese War: Second Battle of San Salvador: The Dutch force the Spanish garrison at San Salvador (modern day Keelung, Taiwan) to surrender, ending the short-lived Spanish colony on Formosa and replacing it with a new Dutch administration.

t: 波威克桥战役,皇家党人和议员的主要野战军之间的第一次接战,以皇家党人的胜利而结束.
te: The Battle of Powick Bridge, the first engagement between the primary field armies of the Royalists and the Parliamenta…
dz: 第一次英国内战:波威克桥战役,皇家党人和议员的主要野战军之间的第一次接战,以皇家党人的胜利而结束.
de: First English Civil War: The Battle of Powick Bridge, the first engagement between the primary field armies of the Royalists and the Parliamentarians, ends in a Royalist victory.

t: 边山战役是英国内战的第一场大规模战役。
te: The Battle of Edgehill is the first major battle of the English Civil War.
dz: 边山战役是英国内战的第一场大规模战役。
de: The Battle of Edgehill is the first major battle of the English Civil War.

t: 特纳姆格林战役:皇家军队面对议会军队而撤退,未能攻取伦敦.
te: Battle of Turnham Green: The Royalist forces withdraw in the face of the Parliamentarian army and fail to take London.
dz: 第一次英国内战:特纳姆格林战役:皇家军队面对议会军队而撤退,未能攻取伦敦.
de: First English Civil War: Battle of Turnham Green: The Royalist forces withdraw in the face of the Parliamentarian army and fail to take London.

t: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)成为第一个发现岛屿"凡·迪门"地(后更名为"塔斯马尼亚…
te: Abel Tasman becomes the first European to discover the island Van Diemen's Land (later renamed Tasmania).
dz: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)成为第一个发现岛屿"凡·迪门"地(后更名为"塔斯马尼亚")的欧洲人.
de: Abel Tasman becomes the first European to discover the island Van Diemen's Land (later renamed Tasmania).

t: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)是第一位有纪录的欧洲人来观看新西兰.
te: Abel Tasman is the first recorded European to sight New Zealand.
dz: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)是第一位有纪录的欧洲人来观看新西兰.
de: Abel Tasman is the first recorded European to sight New Zealand.
